pain.title: Only 37% passed ADI part 1 last year
pain.text: DVSA figures for April 2025 to March 2026 show 31,081 ADI part 1 tests and a 37% pass rate. You need 85 out of 100 overall and at least 20 out of 25 in every band, so one weak band is enough to fail. Visual maps help you cover all four.
pain.source: DVSA ADI qualifying test data (DRT511A): 31,081 tests, 11,512 passes in 2025 to 2026 (provisional).

items.a: The DVSA approved driving instructor (ADI) part 1 theory test in Great Britain: the multiple-choice part with its 4 bands. It is not the learner driver theory test.

This is version {version}. Each map is checked against GOV.UK guidance, The Highway Code or the DVSA national standards, and the date of the check is printed on every page ({checkedOn}). When the rules change, we update the PDFs and you get the new version free.
No. It's an independent revision guide based on the official sources DVSA lists for the test that are free on GOV.UK. All the practice questions are our own, not taken from the DVSA question bank.
The maps cover the multiple-choice part. For hazard perception, practise with video clips, such as the official DVSA e-learning kit.
Right after you pay, Hotmart emails you your access to the members area, where you download the PDFs.
Yes. Every map is an A4 page, made to print at home.

items.q: Does it work on my phone?
items.a: Yes, the PDFs open on any device. They're designed for A4, so on a phone you zoom in. The flashcards also come in a phone version.
No. They're high-resolution PDFs for your personal use.
